newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears Recticel/Greiner joint venture.
newsitem.headline: EU clears Recticel/Greiner joint venture.

text.p: The European Commission said on Thursday it had approved a joint venture between Recticel SA and Greiner Holding AG to manufacture, convert and market flexible polyether and polyester polyeurethane foam.
The Commission said in a statement that the deal would allow the companies to restructure their activity in this sector which is characterised by overcapacity and decreasing demand.

It noted that although the joint venture will become the leading producer in "the rather concentrated" German and Austrian markets, it would face strong comppetition from British Vita, Auto Bock, Reisgies and others.
The deal involves the transfer by both Recticel and Greiner of their activities in the flexible polyether and polyester polyeurethane foam sector in Germany, Austria and eastern European to Eurofoam.
Polyeurethane foam is used in mattresses and car seats, filters, packaging and acoustic materials.

The Commission said that polyeurethane foams are generally characterised by decreasing demand coupled with overcapacity. Products are very similar which tends to lead customers to switch regularly between suppliers. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
